arguments.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== performance worst cases ===" && for f in big1 big2 big3 big4; do echo -n "$f: "; /usr/bin/time -f "%es %MkB" python3 -I -B project/solver.py < /tmp/$f.json > /tmp/out_$f.json 2>/tmp/t_$f || true; cat /tmp/t_$f 2>/dev/null || (time (python3 -I -B project/solver.py < /tmp/$f.json > /tmp/out_$f.json) 2>&1 | grep real); done
